races.paceDynamic: Lisnamult Lad and What Path are confirmed front-runners who will dispute the early lead in this competitive handicap chase. With both horses committed to setting the pace, they'll create an honest gallop from the outset, testing stamina over the extended 3m½f trip on good to soft ground. The strong early pace will stretch the field and set up the race for horses with proven staying power who can close late. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses and strong finishers who can benefit from the strong gallop and pick up the pieces in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Lisnamult Lad and What Path both commit to leading and maintain a solid pace throughout
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will find out the pretenders and set up a tactical finish for horses with proven stamina who can stay the extended trip. Late-closing types like The Goffer, Chemical Energy and Fountain House will benefit from the strong pace scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Setup
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front-runners compromises early or the pace becomes more sedate than expected
scenarios.body: A steadier gallop allows prominent racers and those with tactical speed to stay closer and use their class advantage in the finish. This suits horses like Fakir d'Oudairies, Vanillier and Escaria Ten who can travel strongly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the combination of testing ground and extended distance creates a true staying test
scenarios.body: The race becomes a war of attrition where only the most genuine stayers survive, favouring horses with proven marathon credentials. Busselton's course form and Vital Island's previous success in this race become key assets.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If either Lisnamult Lad or What Path gets an uncontested lead and maintains it
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage by controlling the tempo and has enough left to resist late challenges. This unlikely scenario suits whichever front-runner gets the clearest run.

The Goffer's jumping must be fluent throughout as any mistakes will compromise his strong-finishing style

races.paceDynamic: Lord Lariat will take them along at a steady gallop in this extended staying test, with no other confirmed front-runners to apply early pressure. The real tactical battle unfolds behind him where nine horses want prominent positions - Saint Davy, Intense Raffles, J'Arrive de L'Est, Uncle Pat, Union Station, Daily Present, Brucejack, Will Do, Brideswell Lad, Fishery Lane and Built By Ballymore creating a traffic jam turning for home. This congestion will inevitably compromise several prominent runners 2-3 furlongs out, allowing the patient hold-up horses like Fortunate Man, Jasmin De Grugy, and Better Times Ahead to pick them off. The race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can navigate the carnage and deliver late kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack gets bogged down in traffic approaching the business end
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up brigade find clear runs while prominent runners are shuffling for racing room. Jasmin De Grugy and Fortunate Man capitalize with their superior finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Survivor Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses avoids the traffic and gets first run
scenarios.body: Uncle Pat or J'Arrive de L'Est break clear of the congestion and hold off late challengers. The Mullins factor gives Uncle Pat the edge in a battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Carnage
scenarios.trigger: If Lord Lariat sets too strong a pace and multiple prominent runners hit the wall
scenarios.body: The race falls apart completely with tired horses everywhere creating maximum chaos. An outsider from the back like Sa Majeste sneaks through the wreckage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals
scenarios.trigger: If Lord Lariat is allowed to dictate completely uncontested fractions
scenarios.body: The veteran gets into a rhythm and proves impossible to peg back despite the finish being uphill. His 11-year-old guile trumps younger legs.

watchPoints.text: Watch the prominent pack of 9-10 horses create absolute mayhem 2-3 furlongs out when racing room becomes premium
Lord Lariat could steal this if the field allows him uncontested fractions and he gets into comfortable rhythm
Jasmin De Grugy and Fortunate Man are the two hold-up horses with the class to capitalize on expected chaos
Uncle Pat has Paul Townend aboard who could find a way through traffic where others fail
Several 5lb and 7lb claimers on prominent horses could get badly hampered when the squeeze comes

races.paceDynamic: High Class Hero is the sole confirmed front runner in this 23-runner field and will get his own way out front without pace pressure. The prominent brigade including Your Darling, Bill Baxter, and Beachcomber will track behind but none are aggressive enough to challenge the early lead. This creates a sustainable tempo throughout the 3m½f trip, allowing High Class Hero to dictate fractions and kick clear when ready. This pace setup strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace without energy expenditure, while the large field of hold-up horses will face traffic problems and need luck in running.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: High Class Hero Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If High Class Hero maintains his jumping rhythm and stays sound
scenarios.body: The Mullins runner controls every yard with no pressure and has enough left to repel late challenges. His class advantage tells when it matters most.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can sit close enough without racing keenly
scenarios.body: Your Darling or Bill Baxter can track the leader's every move and pounce when High Class Hero's stamina wanes. The tactical advantage of cover without losing position proves decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Gets Lucky
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and traffic opens up perfectly
scenarios.body: A classy hold-up performer like The Doyen Chief or Captain Cody gets the dream run through and benefits from others' energy expenditure. The race becomes a sprint finish where class tells.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Staying Battle Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If High Class Hero comes back to the field in the final half-mile
scenarios.body: Multiple horses converge for a grueling finish where stamina becomes paramount over tactics. The 3m½f trip finds out those not bred to stay.

races.paceDynamic: Dani Donadoni stands alone as the confirmed front-runner, likely to get an uncontested lead with sustainable fractions early on. However, the real issue develops behind him as 8 prominent runners (Storm Heart, Laurets d'Estruval, Jump Allen, Sony Bill, Kel Histoire, Fierce Handay, Thisistheway, One Big Boum) create a traffic jam in the crucial positions. This congestion will force several to race wider than ideal or get shuffled back when the pace quickens 2-3 furlongs out. The hold-up horses (Hello Neighbour, Tripoli Flyer, Iberico Lord, Wendrock) gain a significant tactical advantage from this set-up, able to pick their way through the inevitable gaps as the prominent brigade ties up.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prosper
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group engages too early and creates pace pressure from 3f out
scenarios.body: The congested prominent runners will compromise each other's finishing kicks while the patient hold-up horses find racing room late. Hello Neighbour and Tripoli Flyer are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario with their proven stamina.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-runner steals it
scenarios.trigger: If Dani Donadoni gets easy fractions and the prominent group fails to organize effectively
scenarios.body: The leader capitalizes on the tactical confusion behind him, maintaining enough in reserve to hold off late challengers. His recent form suggests he has the class to make this pay.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent survivor emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can secure an ideal position without getting trapped

races.paceDynamic: Thewaybackhome represents the only confirmed front-runner in this 25-runner charity race field and should be able to dictate terms unchallenged early. With most of the field holding up or positioned mid-pack, including the stronger-rated runners like Lightkeeper, In Excelsis Deo, and Mordor, the pace is likely to be steady rather than searching. The prominent runners Touch The Moon, Oogum Boogum, Smackwater Jack, Indulging, and Riggs will track behind but won't apply serious early pressure. This sets up perfectly for hold-up horses who can benefit from the inevitable bunching and scrambling in the straight when 20+ runners converge from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates the expected steady pace with late convergence
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of experienced hold-up performers will prove decisive as they sweep past tiring leaders. Horses like Lightkeeper, Mordor, and In Excelsis Deo can time their runs perfectly from the back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracking Works
scenarios.trigger: If Touch The Moon or other prominent runners can secure ideal positions just behind the leader
scenarios.body: These tactical runners avoid the worst of the scrimmaging while staying close enough to strike. Touch The Moon's recent form and Riggs's track record make them natural beneficiaries.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Thewaybackhome gets soft fractions and the field fails to organize a serious challenge
scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter could exploit the lack of early pressure to build an unassailable lead. However, Thewaybackhome's fading tendency makes this unlikely over 2m.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If even the prominent runners sit too far back and nobody goes with Thewaybackhome early
scenarios.body: An extremely slow early tempo could favor the few horses willing to race closer to the pace. This would require multiple tactical errors from prominent runners.

watchPoints.text: Thewaybackhome's early fractions are crucial - if she goes too fast early she'll fade and if too slow the field bunches dangerously
Touch The Moon needs to secure a prominent position early as the mid-division could become very congested with 25 runners
Lightkeeper's fitness after 219 days off will determine if he can produce his best rating in the finish
Any hold-up horse that gets too far back risks being caught in traffic with such a large field converging late
The inside rail positions could prove advantageous given the likely steady pace and late charge scenario
